summary: Tested the /inscricao/contato error-box visibility bug. Scenario 1 (Celular empty): the .erro-campos-donas element IS created in the Shadow DOM and URL correctly stays on /inscricao/contato, BUT the box is NOT visually visible — its computed style shows visibility:hidden and its bounding rect is at left=-735 (off-screen). Screenshots confirm no red box appears anywhere under the Próximo button. Scenario 2 (all fields valid): correctly navigates to /inscricao/endereco and no error box is created. So the bug fix did NOT resolve the visibility issue.

ui_bugs.issue: The error box is inserted into the WRONG step container. There are multiple <div class='horizontal-step-content ng-trigger-horizontalStepTransition'> siblings in the Angular stepper (one per step: Dados pessoais / Contato / Endereço / ...). The current ancestor-search logic that walks up from the Próximo button and inserts the wrapper as next-sibling of the buttons row picks an INACTIVE step container which has computed styles: visibility:hidden AND transform:matrix(1,0,0,1,-1140,0). This means the error box inherits visibility:hidden and is translated -1140px off to the left. Result: DOM has .erro-campos-donas but user sees nothing.

action_items: Fix mostrarErroCampos() in /app/frontend/public/inscricao-contato.html: when inserting the wrapper, filter the candidate ancestor .horizontal-step-content divs to only the ACTIVE one — the one whose getComputedStyle has visibility:'visible' AND transform:'none' (or matrix without translate). Alternatively, insert the error wrapper next to the Próximo button's IMMEDIATE row (e.g., button.closest('.d-flex, .row, .form-actions').parentElement) but ensure the chosen ancestor's computed visibility is 'visible'. Safest approach: use position:fixed on the wrapper (or append to document.body/shadowRoot root with position:absolute) so it doesn't inherit the inactive step's visibility/transform.
After fix, verify getComputedStyle(box).visibility === 'visible' AND box.getBoundingClientRect().left >= 0 AND left < window.innerWidth.
critical_code_review_comments: The ancestor-walk approach used to locate the buttons row is fragile inside Angular steppers because multiple sibling step-content divs exist simultaneously in the DOM (hidden via visibility+transform). Any code inserting error UI must first confirm it lands inside the currently-active step or bypass the step-content by using a positioning strategy (fixed/absolute + high z-index) that renders in the visible viewport regardless of parent transforms.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (1/2 scenarios PASS — S2 works, S1 fails on visibility)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Shadow host <fd-formulario>. Wait ~5s after goto. Selectors: #formly_28_input_email_0, #formly_28_input-mask_celular_3, #formly_28_select_meioDeDivulgacao_1. Próximo button: filter shadowRoot buttons by text 'próximo' AND offsetWidth>0 (there are hidden duplicates in inactive step containers). Validation MUST check computed visibility, not just existence. Key inspection payload: getComputedStyle(box).visibility, box.getBoundingClientRect().left/top, and also inspect ALL ancestors up to shadowRoot — the inactive .horizontal-step-content shows visibility:hidden + transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,-1140,0).
rca of the issue: The Angular stepper renders ALL step-content <div class='horizontal-step-content'> panels simultaneously in DOM. The active step has visibility:visible + transform:none; inactive steps have visibility:hidden + transform:translateX(-1140px). The mostrarErroCampos() ancestor-walk from the clicked Próximo button lands on an inactive step's container (probably because there are multiple 'Próximo'-like buttons in the DOM, or the walk picks the first matching ancestor which happens to be inactive). The wrapper is then inserted inside that inactive step, inheriting visibility:hidden and the -1140px translate. Reproduction: fill email='gege@gmail.com', leave celular empty, pick any meio option, click Próximo — the box is created with correct HTML/text 'Preencha o campo obrigatório: Celular' but rendered off-screen and invisible. Mitigation: (a) filter ancestor .horizontal-step-content candidates to visibility:visible + transform:none, OR (b) insert error box with position:fixed at bottom-right of viewport, OR (c) append to shadowRoot root instead of walking DOM.
